MAY REED TO ARUN MOSS. July 13, 1840
Dear colleague,
May Reed asked Arun Moss to send the orchard inventory.

MAY REED TO ARUN MOSS. July 13, 1840
Dear colleague,
The depot reported receiving a copy of the orchard
inventory, but the sender was not recorded.
Inventory leaf 1. The archive cupboard held a woolen cover beside an unrelated register. No dispatch is recorded here.
